Review and certification responsibilities
ABPI review support and final certification

Compliance review, medical review, internal approval and final certification are distinct decisions. For UK promotional material, the ABPI Code sets requirements for certification of the final form by an eligible nominated signatory. Outsourcing a review task does not itself confer certification authority.

Any signatory support must be separately agreed, including eligibility, product knowledge, experience and nomination requirements. Your company retains oversight of the process and its responsibilities under the applicable rules.
Official reference: PMCPA Clause 8 — Certification and Examination
EFPIA and local-market requirements

European support needs to account for the EFPIA Code alongside applicable national codes and laws. A UK review or certificate should not be assumed to satisfy another market’s requirements. We agree the markets, local expertise and decision routes within the scope.
Official reference: EFPIA Code

Does Eunomia provide outsourced pharmaceutical copy approval support in the UK?

Yes. Eunomia provides promotional and medical materials review and copy approval process support, including specialist reviewers, workflows, SOPs, templates, records and reporting. The exact roles, capacity and markets are agreed for each engagement.
Can you support ABPI and EFPIA promotional review?

The service can support UK review under the ABPI Code and coordination of European review with relevant local expertise. Applicable national requirements, products and reviewer suitability must be confirmed when scoping the service.
Does outsourced review include final medical signatory certification?

Not automatically. Review and final certification are distinct. Any nominated signatory role must be separately agreed and meet the applicable qualifications, knowledge, experience and nomination requirements. An ordinary reviewer approval does not replace certification.
Can you work within our existing review system?
Yes. The service is designed around your SOPs and systems, with access, training, roles and evidence requirements agreed during setup. Specific platform requirements should be confirmed at scoping.
Can AI or workflow automation approve promotional materials?
Automation can support submission checks, routing, version control and reporting. It does not replace accountable human review or the eligible nominated signatory’s required certification decision.
